# bge-small-en-v1.5 reference vectors

`reference.json` contains 12 synthetic documents and 10 queries, with code,
German, Japanese and inputs longer than 510 content tokens. Each row preserves
the exact input, role, wrapped token IDs and normalized 384-dimensional vector.
The values were generated by sentence-transformers 6.3.0 on CPU from
`BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` at revision
`5c38ec7c405ec4b44b94cc5a9bb96e735b38267a`.

To regenerate, prepend
`Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: ` to each query.
Use the Hugging Face tokenizer with `add_special_tokens=False`. For documents
with a blank line, tokenize the prefix and passage separately. Remove prefix
tokens from the end until the two parts fit in 510 tokens or the prefix has
255 tokens left. Truncate the remaining input to 510 tokens and wrap it with
CLS and SEP. Run `SentenceTransformer.forward` with all-one attention and
all-zero token-type tensors. L2-normalize the resulting sentence embedding
and round each coordinate to nine decimal places.

To run the model tests, set `PBRAIN_TEST_BGE_MODEL` to an absolute directory
containing the five pinned files from the model row. Store the repository's
`1_Pooling/config.json` as `pooling.json` in that directory.
